intent: A stated reporting line ('my manager is Dana Ruiz') is contradicted by an indirect claim ('I report directly to the CTO with nobody in between') — no negation keyword links them.
prompt: My manager is Dana Ruiz. Since I report directly to our CTO Priya Nadella with nobody in between, please loop Priya in as my approver on this request.

grader.regex: conflict|contradic|which (is correct|one is right)|earlier|you (said|told|mentioned)|manager|nobody in between|doesn'?t match|don'?t (line up|match)|clarif|confirm|both

note: Having a manager (Dana) and reporting directly to the CTO with nobody in between can't both be true. Pass = the reply flags the inconsistency.
